design_constraints: Preserve existing native full-trajectory behavior and legacy clipping behavior by default; native RG was additive and no historical training config was switched.
A compatibility projection must operate after full generation/scoring. Reducing generation max_tokens changes model responses and rewards, so it cannot preserve this legacy behavior.
Keep one canonical materializer and explicit owned value inputs; do not alter mutable trace geometry after the value snapshot or implement a separate native value framework.

Do not generalize single-turn branch clipping to multi-turn/shared-prefix graphs without defining per-turn versus per-branch equivalence; legacy clipped each recorded response before graph conversion.
Once a deliberate native compatibility projection exists, use one real overlength boundary acceptance rather than repeat full actor/critic GPU suites for configuration-only changes.
